input.title: Give the jobs email input a label by pointing it at the visible prompt
input.rationale: The email input has no accessible name. The paragraph just before it (id="jobs-label") says "Want to work with us? Tell us your email." It is the visible prompt for this field and already has an id we can use. Adding aria-labelledby="jobs-label" makes screen readers read that same text as the input's name, so what users see and what they hear match. A reviewer should check this in a screen reader. A real <label> element would be a good follow-up because clicking it would also move focus to the field.
